messages:
Sam (Partnerships): Quick sync — aiming to deliver a partner-ready reference architecture + Terraform kit for CloudPartner X by next Wed. Core ask: owners for templates, test matrix (Graviton/Ampere/NVIDIA), docs, and marketplace packaging. PR checklist below.

Maria (DevEx): I can own templates + examples. Where will the sample app live? partner-iac repo?

Aj (Cloud PM): partner-iac repo is fine. We should agree on module naming. Preference: `redwood-partner-<cloud>-refarch`. Keep modules composable.

Lee (Arch): I will validate network diagrams, security controls, and KMS integration. Also need a short runbook for Dedicated vs Private deployment differences.

Sam (Partnerships): @Maria please add initial terraform module skeleton under `modules/cloudpartner-x-refarch/`. Include semver policy and CHANGELOG.md in the repo. Add a small example app under `examples/`.

Maria (DevEx): ack — will open PR by EOD. Quick Q: do we want to provide a packaged container image for the on-prem distribution or just instructions?

Lee (Arch): Container images + k8s manifests preferred. Also provide a systemd unit for single-host installs. Keep the runtime image minimal and tag by git SHA and semver.

Aj (Cloud PM): Testing matrix request: CI should run on amd64/arm64 and with/without GPU (nvidia). Can we add matrix entries in the pipeline?

CI Bot: build #452 succeeded — unit tests passed on x86.

NVIDIA Partner Bot: FYI — partner will provide an optimized Triton recipe for Ampere instances. We'll coordinate ROCm/AMD later.

Sam (Partnerships): Timeline proposal: PR by EOD Tue, internal review Wed, partner review Thu, docs + marketplace listing by next Tue. Owners: Maria (templates + examples), Lee (architecture/runbooks/security), Aj (marketplace packaging + partner comms), Sam (partner comms + announcement).

Maria (DevEx): I'll include example usage snippets and a tiny hello-world eval prompt set so partners can sanity-check outputs.

Lee (Arch): Note for Terraform modules: avoid hardcoding instance types or AMIs. Provide example overrides and a `high-throughput` module variant with batching/KV cache config samples. Also add `inputs.tf` documentation for recommended configs.

Aj (Cloud PM): Please add a short "How to deploy on Dedicated vs Private" section in README — customers ask this a lot. Include expected perf/cost tradeoffs.

Sam (Partnerships): Yes, include placeholder perf numbers (we'll replace after benchmarks). Maria, can you stub a perf table with TODO items?

Maria (DevEx): Will do — mocking numbers and adding TODO note in README.

Sam (Partnerships): Also need a lightweight security checklist for partner review: recommended network CIDRs, KMS hints, log retention, and recommended IAM roles. @Lee for sign-off.

Lee (Arch): On it. Quick flag — for Private we must include KMS/HSM integration instructions and audit log paths. I'll draft the section.

Aj (Cloud PM): Partner asked for a short joint announcement draft. Who can do the bullets? I can shepherd after tech sign-off, but need initial draft.

Maria (DevEx): I can draft the "Getting Started" steps and the quickstart snippet.

Sam (Partnerships): Great. Action items recap:
- Maria: open TF skeleton PR + examples + README quickstart + perf placeholder.
- Lee: arch/runbook + security checklist + KMS section + final sign-off.
- Aj: marketplace packaging checklist, announcement shepherd.
- Sam: coordinate partner review and timeline.

Maria (DevEx): opening PR now. Sample module usage I'm adding below for reviewers:
```hcl
module "redwood_partner" {
  source = "git::https://github.com/redwood/partner-iac.git//modules/cloudpartner-x-refarch"
  region = var.region
  node_count = 3
  instance_type = var.instance_type # override per cloud
}
```

Sam (Partnerships): tagging @Lee for final security sign-off. Anything else before we close this thread?

Lee (Arch): Small reminder — include a short troubleshooting table (common errors, logs path, contact for partner support).

Sam (Partnerships): will add a bullet for troubleshooting. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:

CI Bot: integration tests queued — params: os=[linux], arch=[amd64,arm64], gpu=[none,nvidia].
